correctness.rationale: For each of the four orders I reconstructed the outer, inner and spoke edges from congruences on unordered pairs and computed shortest paths by Floyd–Warshall. Each landmark yields a bit mask of unordered edge pairs it distinguishes, using the minimum distance to the two endpoints. A landmark subset resolves if its mask union covers every edge pair. Exhaustive enumeration at cardinalities 1–4 recovers, at 2, 3, and 4 landmarks respectively, (0,0,469), (0,0,368), (0,18,1359), and (0,160,3200), and there are no resolving singletons. Upward closure and the positive counts establish all four minima and optimum counts. The original scalar formula is true, not falsified; §6 and Theorem 1.1 of the primary paper support its finite and infinite parts separately. The corrected files at /workspace/repairs/4/ retain the verified census, with no extrapolation.
residual_risks: No counting result outside the four specified orders is checked or asserted. The stable dimension theorem is credited, not re-proved.
